PNAS2015.title: Origins of stereoselectivity in evolved ketoreductases
locations: main text Enzymatic Activity and Theozyme Calculations
PNAS2015.license: Publicly readable on PMC; explicit article reuse license not independently established in this subtask. Do not infer CC BY from PMC hosting.
PNAS2015.sph_structure_provenance: Main text and Figure5 describe an experimental apo Sph structure among five obtained structures. The Data deposition paragraph lists only four public PDB entries (4RF4,4RF2,4RF5,4RF3) and none for Sph. No publicly deposited Sph coordinate accession has been established here.

Ssal2024.title: Effective engineering of a ketoreductase for the biocatalytic synthesis of an ipatasertib precursor
locations: Supplementary Information section 1.11 (PDF p7), Figure 19 (p26), amino-acid sequences (p55)
Ssal2024.github_license: No LICENSE file found in recursive master tree on 2026-10-07. Public access does not itself establish an open-source license.
Ssal2024.github_label: library9/library9_data.xlsx and library10/library10_data.xlsx use target = slope_variant / slope_wild-type from UV assay; predictions are separate files and must not be relabeled as experiments.
Ssal2024.sequence_source_location: Supplementary Information section 4, PDF page 55; text extracted with pypdf and visually checked against rendered page.
Ssal2024.sequence_mutation_validation: All seven source amino-acid sequences have length 343; direct comparison to reported WT reproduces every mutation list from the main-text M1-M6 descriptions.
assay_source_discrepancies: SI section 1.11 states a generic final substrate range of 1-800 uM, while Supplementary Data 6 contains variant-specific ranges extending to 1000 or 1200 uM. Both are retained rather than forcing the generic range onto all variants.
SI Figure 19 caption says triplicate, but Supplementary Data 6 contains four replicate columns for M2 and M5; reported uncertainty type is not specified in the checked text or figure.

ssal2024_records.source_location: Main Table 2; SI section 1.11/p7, Figure 19/p26; Supplementary Data 6
ssal2024_records.sequence_verification: Verbatim reported enzyme amino-acid sequence from official SI PDF p55, text-extracted and visually checked; exact mutations validated against SI WT. The kinetic construct has an N-terminal 6xHis tag, but that vector-derived tag/linker is absent from this reported 343-aa sequence and has not been reconstructed.
ssal2024_records.substrate_name: prochiral ketone precursor to ipatasertib alcohol intermediate
ssal2024_records.purification_status: Purified N-terminal 6xHis-tagged protein; WT and M1-M6 subcloned into pET28b(+) for kinetics per main Methods.
ssal2024_records.label_qualification: apparent Michaelis-Menten parameters with iPrOH as sacrificial cofactor-regeneration substrate
ssal2024_records.uncertainty_definition: Reported +/- terms retained from Table 2. The checked main text, SI section 1.11 and Figure 19 do not specify whether these are SD, SEM, confidence-interval half-widths, or fitting errors; no statistical type is assigned.
ssal2024_records.conditions_note: Purified-enzyme kinetics verified from SI section 1.11 at 25 C and pH7; distinct from preparative/Table1 and cell-lysate screening conditions. These are apparent constants in the iPrOH-coupled reaction.
ssal2024_records.structure_evidence: Original JMB2005 and 2024 papers describe 1Y1P as WT enzyme co-crystallized with NADPH. Current deposition encodes covalently connected NMN, AMP and PO4 pieces via _struct_conn (not a single NDP/NAP CCD residue). These are not unconnected solvent fragments. Chemical graph/redox-state normalization requires care; assayed ketone 1a was modeled/docked. Exact mutant-substrate ternary crystal structures are not provided.
ssal2024_records.cofactor_encoding_note: Covalent NMN O3P--AMP P and AMP O2prime--PO4 P links are recorded for each cofactor. Preserve deposited coordinates/provenance when normalizing; no target-substrate experimental pose is present.
ssal2024_records.mutation_source: Main text hit-variant descriptions, independently matched to differences between SI p55 amino-acid sequences.

buffer_cofactor_premix.concentration_scope: These are concentrations of the stated 178-uL premix, not asserted final reaction concentrations.

kinetics_assay_conditions.readout: Substrate 1a consumption at 340 nm, converted using a calibration curve of 1a; not an NADPH-depletion readout.
kinetics_assay_conditions.purification: N-terminal 6xHis-tagged proteins, Ni-NTA purification; vector-derived tag/linker sequence is not included in the 343-residue SI enzyme sequences.

raw_kinetic_curve_metadata.replicate_interpretation: Source columns are replicate measurements; biological versus technical replicates is not assigned.

ssal2024_records.structure_evidence: Original JMB2005 and 2024 papers describe 1Y1P as WT enzyme co-crystallized with NADPH. Current deposition encodes covalently connected NMN, AMP and PO4 pieces via _struct_conn (not a single NDP/NAP CCD residue). These are not unconnected solvent fragments. Chemical graph/redox-state normalization requires care; assayed ketone 1a was modeled/docked. Exact mutant-substrate ternary crystal structures are not provided.
notes: Internal source discrepancy retained: narrative kcat 31.5 +/- 0.08 min^-1 versus Table2 31.5 +/- 0.8 min^-1. SI Fig19 gives Vmax 3.153 +/- 0.081 uM min^-1 at E0=0.1 uM. Dividing both Vmax and its +/- term by E0 gives 31.53 +/- 0.81 min^-1, supporting Table2. A missing E0 normalization in the narrative uncertainty is a curator inference, not a published correction. Statistical uncertainty type remains unspecified.
ssal2024_records.cofactor_encoding_note: Covalent NMN O3P--AMP P and AMP O2prime--PO4 P links are recorded for each cofactor. Preserve deposited coordinates/provenance when normalizing; no target-substrate experimental pose is present.
ssal2024_records.mutation_source: Main text hit-variant descriptions, independently matched to differences between SI p55 amino-acid sequences.

buffer_cofactor_premix.concentration_scope: These are concentrations of the stated 178-uL premix, not asserted final reaction concentrations.

kinetics_assay_conditions.readout: Substrate 1a consumption at 340 nm, converted using a calibration curve of 1a; not an NADPH-depletion readout.
kinetics_assay_conditions.purification: N-terminal 6xHis-tagged proteins, Ni-NTA purification; vector-derived tag/linker sequence is not included in the 343-residue SI enzyme sequences.

raw_kinetic_curve_metadata.replicate_interpretation: Source columns are replicate measurements; biological versus technical replicates is not assigned.

global_curation_rules: Do not treat ND as zero.
Keep kinetics, normalized UV slope, endpoint product concentration, conversion, and ee/de separate.
Retain original units; conversions provided here are mathematical only.
Require exact experimental construct sequence and assayed substrate match to claim structure-activity pair.
Cofactor-only experimental structures plus docked substrates are not true experimental ternary complexes.
